text:
If you're under 25 and confused by women, read this twice.

Her attraction runs on a monthly cycle. Some weeks she wants the bold, confident you. Other weeks she wants the calm, steady, emotionally present you.

She's not changing her mind. Her biology is shifting what she needs.

Learn the pattern now. Stop reacting. Start understanding.

Boys panic at the shift. Men learn it.
caption:
The discipline to learn dating psychology and understand attraction saves men years of confusion during self improvement.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
